verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software platform with production data, so a sandbox test environment is a category error for this kind of product. The mention of CAM helping incubated startups with 'Beta testing of their developed products' refers to supporting those startups' own products. It is not a sandbox the firm ships to users, so it does not make the axis applicable.
